newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to sell May 2-3 light naphtha.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to sell May 2-3 light naphtha.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell 110,000-125,000 barrels of light naphtha for May 2-3 lifting on a free-on board (fob) basis to Colombo, a CPC source said on Monday.
The tender closes on April 23 and bids are valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC sold to Japanese trader Tomen 110,000-125,000 barrels of light naphtha at 88 cents per barrel below Singapore spot quotes, for March 24-25 lifting fob Colombo.
